summary: Foghorn Therapeutics filed an 8-K to furnish a corporate presentation (Exhibit 99.1) and announce preclinical data from the 2026 AACR Annual Meeting (Exhibit 99.2), including updates on FHD-909 and degrader programs. This is an ordinary disclosure of materials intended for investor meetings and scientific conference data dissemination—not a special situation event. No transaction, activist, restructuring, or capital return activity is reported. The filing is standard for a pharmaceutical company communicating operational progress.
